name: learning_answer_support
comment: Uncalibrated GEval; supplied-source support only. Both stones are correctly listed as available, and the answer distinguishes Madame Obsidian’s harmonious type pairing from Sir Pebble’s conditional pairing without assuming the household agreements are met. It explains Madame’s quiet-home fit and relevant care needs, but omits Sir Pebble’s individual suitability: his biography says he enjoys quiet evenings.
